test_await_async_support: test that a pybind11 C++ class supports async await by running it through an asyncio event loop and verifying the result
test_await_missing_async: test that awaiting a pybind11 C++ class without async support raises a TypeError when run through an asyncio event loop
create_event_loop_fixture: create a pytest fixture that creates a new asyncio event loop for async test cases and closes it after the test
run_get_await_result: run an async function that awaits a pybind11 object and returns the awaited result value
review_async_test_patterns: review the pybind11 async test patterns including event loop fixtures and async await verification for C++ bound classes
